title: The Board
hint: Drag to turn the board · scroll to come closer · point at a territory for its name, click to go in · every project on it is fictional
skin: :root{--page:#0a0e18;--ink:#eadfc8;--body:"Avenir Next","Helvetica Neue",sans-serif;--title:500 13px/1 "Iowan Old Style","Palatino Linotype",Palatino,Georgia,serif;--title-track:.34em;--title-case:uppercase;--title-ink:#cdb88a;--plate-ink:#8f93a3;--panel:rgba(13,17,28,.9);--panel-ink:#ece1ca;--panel-soft:#a69d88;--panel-border:1px solid rgba(217,166,64,.45);--radius:2px;--panel-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.6);--heading:500 23px/1.15 "Iowan Old Style","Palatino Linotype",Palatino,Georgia,serif;--heading-track:.01em;--heading-case:none;--rule:1px solid rgba(217,166,64,.28);--chip-radius:0;--chip-border:0;--accent:#c9983c;--on-accent:#14100a;--button-border:0;--button-radius:2px;--focus:#f3e6c8}body #plate{padding:0;background:none;border-radius:0;left:34px;top:30px;opacity:.85}#tally,#plate .specimen{display:none}body #hint{left:34px;bottom:26px;font:italic 13px/1.4 "Iowan Old Style",Palatino,Georgia,serif;color:#9a9483;letter-spacing:.02em;animation:hintout 1.6s 9s forwards}.still #hint{display:none}@keyframes hintout{to{opacity:0}}aside{backdrop-filter:blur(8px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}aside .note{color:#cdbf9f}body #back{left:34px;font:500 12px/1 "Iowan Old Style",Palatino,Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:11px 16px 10px}aside .down{display:block;width:100%;margin:16px 0 2px;padding:12px 16px 11px;font:500 12px/1 "Iowan Old Style",Palatino,Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#14100a;background:#c9983c;border:0;border-radius:2px;cursor:pointer}aside .down:hover{background:#dcae52}aside .down:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #f3e6c8;outline-offset:3px}
